system.description:
Potence is more than hitting a thing until it stops moving: you strike or stamp the ground and the force erupts from the earth a distance away, beneath your chosen target.

Spend a Blood Trait and win a Physical Challenge against a target within ten feet per level of Potence to erupt a geyser of debris beneath them, inflicting three levels of lethal damage. Used against a car it disables the vehicle unless armored; used indoors or over gaps, the target may face a Static Physical Challenge against six Traits to avoid falling through the hole the blow tears open.
